description: Architectural rules for Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS), event immutability, and projection decoupling.

rules.name: Strict Command & Query Model Segregation
rules.description: Commands must only perform state mutations and return void/result status (no complex query projections). Queries must be side-effect free and never mutate state.
rules.rationale: Prevents subtle race conditions, optimizes read/write scalability independently, and maintains clear cognitive separation between read and write models.
rules.remediation: Split combined handlers into explicit CommandHandler and QueryHandler classes.

rules.name: Absolute Immutability of Domain Events
rules.description: Domain events persisted in an Event Store or published to a message bus must be append-only and immutable. Modifying past events is strictly prohibited.
rules.rationale: Event streams represent the historical source of truth. Mutating past events breaks auditability and corrupts read model replays.
rules.remediation: To correct mistakes, publish a compensating event (e.g., OrderRefunded, ItemReturned) rather than updating prior events.

rules.name: Asynchronous Read Projection Decoupling
rules.description: Read model projections must be updated via asynchronous event subscribers and must never block the write command transaction.
rules.rationale: Keeps write path latency minimal and prevents read model projection failures from rolling back valid business commands.
rules.remediation: Update materialized read views asynchronously via background event handlers or change data capture (CDC).
